configuration.claudeUsagePath.descriptio: Local Claude Code usage path. Leave empty to automatically apply detected local sources.
configuration.codexUsagePath.description: Local Codex usage path. Leave empty to automatically apply detected local sources.
configuration.locale.description: Dashboard language. Use auto to follow the VS Code display language.
configuration.timeZoneMode.description: Dashboard time zone mode. Use system to follow this machine, utc for UTC, or custom with an IANA time zone.
configuration.customTimeZone.description: Custom IANA time zone for the dashboard, such as Asia/Taipei. Used only when timeZoneMode is custom.
configuration.autoRefreshIntervalSeconds: Auto refresh interval in seconds. Use 0 to stop auto refresh. Values from 1 to 29 are treated as 30 seconds. The recommended default is 300 seconds.
configuration.autoDetectLocalSources.des: Automatically detect and apply local Claude Code and Codex usage paths.
